purpose: Lock third-party skill research inputs without installing or vendoring them.

policy.adopt_policy: No complete third-party skill is adopted verbatim. The project design requires a reviewed rewrite before inclusion.
policy.execution_boundary: No repository script was run, no package was installed, and no external issue tracker or Git-mutating operation was invoked; repository metadata was inspected read-only.

repositories.relationship: Chinese-language reference checkout supplied for comparison; it is not treated as an authoritative upstream replacement.

decisions.reason: Keep primary-source evidence and claim traceability; remove mandatory background-agent dispatch and automatic repository-note creation, then distinguish facts, inferences, and unknowns.
Keep red-green feedback discipline; align seam confirmation and commands with the target repository rather than copying source wording.
Keep reproducible feedback-loop and evidence-first diagnosis; retain this project's no-secret and authorization boundaries.
Reuse the separation of specification and standards review as an independently rewritten rubric.
Reuse the context-budget and progressive-disclosure concerns, rewritten with verified platform differences.
Keep explicit clarification and domain-language capture; do not force interviews or write ADRs without authorization.
Keep scope, decisions, test strategy and exclusions; remove issue-tracker publication and label mutation.
Keep vertical slices and blocking-edge reasoning; remove tracker writes and external state changes.
Keep question-led, throwaway experiments; remove the requirement to commit or create branches.
Keep shared-language clarification, scenario checks, code comparison, and the three-condition ADR threshold; require authorization before creating or changing context and ADR records.
Keep deep-module vocabulary and interface/seam analysis; reject seams justified only by a hypothetical single implementation and make design alternatives optional rather than mandatory parallel work.

Keep bounded hotspot analysis, evidence-backed candidates, and stated recommendation strength; remove automatic history-wide scanning, HTML artifact generation, follow-up workflow control, and repository side effects.

Keep confirmed-spec work organized into verified small batches and route TDD, debugging, and review at appropriate seams; remove automatic commit, issue-tracker mutation, and execution beyond confirmed authorization.
They depend on installation, external trackers, hooks, credential provisioning, Git state changes, or a specific tool ecosystem outside this task's authorized scope.
